search.title: Collections
search.description: Find a customer or a contract and take installment payments. Contracts of every branch are listed.
search.placeholder: Contract number, customer name, phone or national ID
search.loadFailed: The contracts could not be loaded.

collect.title: Take a payment
collect.description: Tick the contracts the customer pays and the amount for each. Every amount goes to the oldest installment first. No late fees are ever charged.
collect.noShift: Open a shift to take payments: the cash goes into your drawer.
collect.revoked: This computer is no longer paired. Ask a manager to pair it again.
collect.loadFailed: The customer's contracts could not be loaded.
collect.noOpenContracts: This customer has no contract with anything left to pay.
collect.above: More than what is left on this contract ({amount}).
collect.pick: Tick a contract and enter an amount.

errors.dueChanged: Another payment was taken on this contract a moment ago. The amounts were reloaded: check them and try again.
errors.exceeds: That is more than what is left on the contract. The amounts were reloaded.
errors.notOpen: This contract is closed: nothing is left to pay.
errors.failed: The payment could not be taken. Try again.

pay.title: Collect the payment
pay.description: How does the customer pay? Cash, bank transfers or both. Collect opens when the lines add up to the total.

receipt.title: Receipt {number}
receipt.loadFailed: The receipt could not be loaded.
receipt.copyNote: This receipt was printed before: it prints as a COPY.

reverse.title: Reverse receipt {number}
reverse.description: The money goes back to the customer and the installments become unpaid again. Only today's latest collection of these contracts can be reversed.

errors.not_same_day: Only a collection from today can be reversed. Older mistakes are corrected by a manager later.
errors.not_latest: A later payment was taken on one of these contracts: reverse that one first.
errors.shift_closed: The shift that took this payment is closed: the cash can't go back out of its drawer.
errors.insufficient: There is not enough cash in the drawer to give back.
errors.failed: The collection could not be reversed.
errors.settlement: This collection paid an early settlement: it can't be reversed.
errors.contract_changed: The contract was rescheduled or settled after this collection: it can't be reversed.
